scientific_question: After universal procedural c_proj replacement fails, can an LWT-style exception set of at most four dense c_proj layers recover most of the c_fc-only parent's terminal advantage while the other c_proj layers remain procedural?

joint_full_mlp.conclusion: The full procedural MLP is stable but 0.034405 CE behind the accepted c_fc-only parent.

cfc_only_parent.conclusion: c_fc procedural replacement is accepted; dense c_proj is the remaining MLP bottleneck.

parallel_transport.conclusion: Both forward and inverse compression-error transport lose endpoint recovery in all five layers, closing temporal gauge as the universal repair.

evidence.paper_alignment: The Mapping Networks paper motivates layer-wise training because different layers occupy different manifolds. This diagnostic tests exception allocation rather than claiming one universal c_proj manifold.

analysis.donor_tensors: only transformer.h.{0..11}.mlp.c_proj.weight from the c_fc-only checkpoint

variants.joint_control: No donor c_proj layer is inserted.
variants.all12_restore_control: All twelve donor dense c_proj tensors are inserted; this measures the maximum immediate cross-run restore signal in the joint context.
variants.single_layer_restores: Insert one donor c_proj layer at a time on the primary window and rank by CE gain, breaking ties by smaller layer index.
variants.primary_ranked_cumulative: Evaluate cumulative top-k sets for k in [1,2,3,4,6,8,10,12] on both windows. Confirmation tokens never change the ordering.

analysis.restore_contract: Copy full c_proj tensors only, evaluate, and restore the exact joint tensors bitwise after each arm. No interpolation, rescaling, refit, optimizer step, or other model-state change.
prohibited: row or channel selection within a layer

decision_rule.pass: Select the smallest cumulative k in ascending order that clears every restore-control and candidate requirement. A pass authorizes only a separately preregistered mixed-layer model/config implementation, correctness and exact-resume tests, then an exact-config MFU gate at or above 20 percent.
decision_rule.fail: Reject donor-layer exception allocation as nonportable in the joint context. Do not tune seeds, thresholds, interpolation, or layer subsets after measurement.

execution_policy.mfu_gate: not applicable to a zero-update terminal counterfactual
